observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A banquet hall or wedding reception venue with tables, chairs, guests seated on the sides, and a polished marble dance floor.
observation.dancers: A group of young men in suits, some holding flags or sticks, joined in a line.
observation.formation_and_space: A line of dancers holding hands or arms linked, moving sideways across the dance floor.
observation.posture: Torso upright, knees bending flexibly with steps, body weight shifting rhythmically.
observation.footwork: Stepping sideways, stamping, crossing feet, and lifting knees high on the beat; fast footwork details obscured by camera motion.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out and linked or holding hands with neighbors; some dancers wave flags or sticks overhead or clap in unison.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively upright with natural bounciness matching the steps; slight upper body leaning during high kicks.
observation.partnering: Group line formation with hand-to-hand contact or arm links between dancers.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Upright level with energetic jumps, high knee lifts, and simultaneous stomping on the beat.
observation.costume_and_props: Men wearing business suits, dress shirts, and ties; some holding Palestinian flags and decorated sticks.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement details and precise weight distribution are difficult to see due to wide camera angles and rapid panning.

signature_moments.what: Dancers link hands in a line and perform coordinated high knee lifts and side steps.
The line of dancers jumps simultaneously while holding hands.
Energetic kicking and high-stepping in unison along the line.
Dancers clap rhythmically together while stepping in place.
Stomping and fast cross-step pattern traveling sideways.
